from django.db.models import DecimalField, FloatField, IntegerField, DateField
from django.db.models.expressions import CombinedExpression, Combinable, Value

dec = Value(1, output_field=DecimalField(max_digits=5, decimal_places=2))
integ = Value(2, output_field=IntegerField())
flt = Value(2.0, output_field=FloatField())
date = Value('2020-01-01', output_field=DateField())

cases = [
    ('decimal % integer', dec, integ, DecimalField),
    ('integer % decimal', integ, dec, DecimalField),
    ('integer % float', integ, flt, FloatField),
    ('float % integer', flt, integ, FloatField),
    ('decimal % decimal', dec, dec, DecimalField),
    ('integer % integer', integ, integ, IntegerField),
]
for label, lhs, rhs, expected in cases:
    field = CombinedExpression(lhs, Combinable.MOD, rhs).output_field
    print(f'{label}: {type(field).__name__}')
    assert isinstance(field, expected), (label, type(field), expected)

try:
    CombinedExpression(integ, Combinable.MOD, date).output_field
except Exception as exc:
    print('integer % date ->', type(exc).__name__)
    assert type(exc).__name__ == 'FieldError'
else:
    raise AssertionError('invalid MOD combination did not raise')

# Other operators must be unchanged.
for op, label in [(Combinable.ADD, 'add'), (Combinable.SUB, 'sub'), (Combinable.MUL, 'mul'), (Combinable.DIV, 'div')]:
    field = CombinedExpression(dec, op, integ).output_field
    assert isinstance(field, DecimalField), (label, type(field))
print('ALL MOD/edge-case checks passed')
